paragraphs: E-ONE manufactures custom, heavy-duty fire trucks. The line covers pumpers, tankers, aerial ladders and platforms, rescues, industrial units and aircraft rescue and firefighting vehicles. Those trucks reach fire departments through a dealer network.

The company was founded in 1974 by an industrial engineer and says it designed and manufactured the first modular, extruded aluminum fire truck and body. A company timeline runs from that first modular all-aluminum body through decades of chassis, ladders and platforms. The same timeline records testing cabs in excess of the European ECE-R29 crash worthiness standard. Recent entries include an all-electric fire truck called the Vector.

E-ONE writes that first responders and the communities they serve have relied on it for 50 years. The timeline notes that American Industrial Partners purchased the company. Company news reports an order from the Chicago Fire Department for 120 emergency vehicles from E-ONE and Wheeled Coach. Another post describes a $23.5 million expansion expected to increase aerial production by 35 percent and add 100 new jobs in Ocala.

quote.text: E-ONE MANUFACTURES CUSTOM, HEAVY-DUTY FIRE TRUCKS.
